verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an OpenAPI spec published at vercel.com/openapi.json, LLM-friendly markdown docs, and copyable CLI/SDK examples such as `sandbox run echo "Hello Sandbox!"`. None of it shows an interactive API reference where examples can be run in place, so the support is only glancing. Missing for 10: an interactive explorer or try-it console, runnable in-docs examples, confirmation that the OpenAPI spec covers Sandbox endpoints, and hands-on corroboration.
